    __handle_flag()
    {
        __debug "${FUNCNAME[0]}: c is $c words[c] is ${words[c]}"

        # if a long flag was found
        if [[ ${words[c]} == --*=* ]]; then
            # The flag has an argument, handled as the previous word
            c=$((c+1))
            return 1
        fi

        # if a short flag was found
        if [ ${words[c]} == -* ]]; then
            c=$((c+1))
            # if this is a flag that requires an argument
            if [[ -n "${two_word_flags[*]}" ]]; then
                if [[ ${words[c-1]} =~ ${two_word_flags[*]} ]]; then
                    # treat next word as argument
                    c=$((c+1))
                fi
            fi
            return 0
        fi

        return 1
    }

    __handle_subcommand()
    {
        __debug "${FUNCNAME[0]}"
        local cmd="${1}"

        # find the previous flag
        if declare -F "${cmd}_command_completion_func" > /dev/null 2>&1; then
            "${cmd}_command_completion_func"
        fi
    }
